svg.title: Best-fit allocation filling a four-compartment locker
svg.desc: Compartments S1 and S2 are small, M1 medium, L1 large. P1 and P2 are small and take S1 and S2. P3 is small but both smalls are taken, so it goes one size up into M1. P4 is medium, M1 is taken, so it goes into L1. P5 is 70 cm long, longer than any compartment, and is refused. P6 is small but nothing is free, so it is refused.
svg.text: deposits in order P1 .. P6, smallest free size that fits
70 cm, but L is only 60 long
